paper: ARC2-Global: Tangent-Corrected Alignment for Embedding-Index Migration
summary: A coherent compact directional adapter and a substantial matched mixed-gallery evaluation support a weak accept for DASFAA. Development gains over Procrustes are broad and the second step adds value. Prospective evidence supports specific neural/regression advantages and geometric competitiveness, rather than a confirmed incremental Procrustes gain.
strongest_rejection_argument: The proposed algorithm is an incremental combination of Procrustes initialization and residual ridge fitting in an area with substantial existing alignment and backfilling work. Its main gain over the strongest simple comparator is measured on collections used for development; the only prospectively held collection gives Procrustes higher point means in every migration/budget cell. The large confirmed gains instead concern neural/regression configurations with restricted paired-only training and validation, so they do not establish superiority over those original methods in their usual regimes. The all-paid E5 experiment also favors the existing geometric maps. Therefore the evidence may establish a useful candidate adapter and careful migration evaluation, but not a sufficiently general advantage of the new directional correction to justify a full method paper.

prioritized_fixes.action: Lead with the specific tangent-residual correction and affine inference; replace contrast counts with a scoped, interpretable prospective result.
Contrast anchor-specific tangent correction with principal-direction residual shaping across translators in mixing/chaining.
Explain the measured MiniLM 75 percent operating point and E5 regression/neural gains; retain concise geometric comparator scope.
Reduce locked/frozen workflow phrasing and excessive numeric precision while preserving exact settings and evidence distinctions.
Add an anonymous artifact access statement if available, linking readers to configurations, generated evidence and per-query records; no publication authorization is implied.

optional_experiments.action: One separately preregistered untouched-collection comparison of frozen ARC2 against Procrustes under matched budgets and both migrations.
optional_experiments.purpose: Test transfer of the actual incremental correction rather than collect more wins over weaker configurations.
optional_experiments.authorization: Not performed; requires the established immutable protocol and run rules.

irreducible_current_limits: No prospective advantage over Procrustes or LA2M is established.
Bootstrap inference conditions on observed seeds and fixed collections.
All-paid comparison uses one development collection.
Cached-vector exposure and coefficient bytes do not measure physical end-to-end migration cost.
